scope: Static review of archived target native geometry, touch guards, preference click ABI and secondary-character route; reported device-wide failure is unresolved

checks.finding: onSizeChanged scales touch coordinates by 1/width and 1/height; native key geometry is normalized.
n(float,float) tests e.a RectF, applying edge-extension flags e.c. Root helper should require finite coordinates and unique hit; optional strict e.a.contains avoids edge capture.
d:ArrayList holds fc0.f instances; concrete fc0.n2 has behavior b:oc0.l, state d:fc0.d2 and geometry e:fc0.m1.
oc0.m.b:hc0.a owns c:hc0.k. Native long-press handler uses its configured timeout c.a and action lists.
n(ef0.p) invokes j(event,c.d), the native long-press release action collection.
static a(Collection,fc0.d2) evaluates each restriction against live key state and returns active actions.
Long-press action registration wraps ic0.a with ic0.e through ic0.d.a and stores under hc0.o condition.
m(...) handles xc0.i secondary popup keyText b, computes optional output normalization, creates fc0.d1 with d=true and registers through hc0.b.p into hc0.k.d.
b(lh0.a) calls its fc0.k1.d native wb0.t0.P(token,b,c,null,d,null). Reusing this actor keeps native composition and output behavior.
b(...) creates shift-specific conditional long-press action branches using native restrictions; hc0.o.a selection must be repeated before release.
f(token,MotionEvent) forwards events into native ef0.d touch dispatch. A synthetic CANCEL calls native path directly without reentering JapaneseGlide onTouch hook.

Native row layout cumulatively adds float widths and padding without clamping to 1; ten float32 0.1 widths sum to 1.0000001192092896. Strict right<=1 incorrectly rejects that edge key. A finite 1e-4 normalized epsilon allows only rounding-scale boundary drift.
Native RectF receives SizedKey b/c/d/e coordinates directly.
b() is AccessibilityManager.isEnabled() && isTouchExplorationEnabled(), not a popup-state check. Existing exclusion is retained.
Preference.f uses oa.k whose k(Preference) returns void. Diagnostic listener implements this exact interface.
Public f:oa.k is the preference click listener; diagnostic only copies on explicit click.

required_runtime_guards: Japanese QWERTY layout and JAPANESE search type
single eligible pointer, valid view/window/layout/editor/connection across stroke
native popup routing map empty and accessibility touch exploration disabled
unique native secondary fc0.d1 actor with d=true and exactly one printable output character
resolve active long-release actor using native restrictions at DOWN and UP and require same identity
native CANCEL once before actor.b(token), consume UP even after cancellation failure to avoid duplicate native commit
yield nonqualifying paths to existing native/glide handling
do not assume every popup key has a single secondary action
device_wide_failure_cause: Not established. Diagnostic refusal stages and counts are needed from the actual device.
diagnostic_scope: In-memory event counts and constant refusal stages; version and enabled flag; exception class only; never text/key label/editor content/app name. Clipboard write only on explicit diagnostic preference click.
